question: Create a hypothesis for the following scenario: A bar magnet is dropped vertically through a long, hollow aluminum cylinder. If the magnet is flipped so that the South pole points downwards instead of the North pole, and dropped again, how will the acceleration compare to the first case?

options.A: The acceleration will be greater in the second case.
options.B: The acceleration will be smaller in the second case.
options.C: The acceleration will be identical in both cases (less than $g$).
options.D: The acceleration will be equal to $g$ in the second case.
